topic: 意识知觉的时间解剖学：从17ms到300ms的神经处理门槛

sources.authors: Del Cul A, Baillet S, Dehaene S
sources.title: Brain dynamics underlying the nonlinear threshold for access to consciousness
sources.role: 主要来源：逆向遮蔽实验，P3是唯一非线性意识标记，270ms门槛
sources.key_data: SOA 16-100ms; P1a(85ms)/N1(150ms)/N2(180ms) 无意识特征; P3(270-370ms) Sigmoid非线性; 平均阈限SOA=43.9ms

sources.authors: Gaillard R, Dehaene S, Adam C, et al.
sources.title: Converging intracranial markers of conscious access
sources.role: 主要来源：颅内记录，四重意识标记，意识vs无意识激活持续时间对比
sources.key_data: 10名患者,176电极; 无意识激活60ms vs 意识激活378ms; 长程beta同步(13-30Hz); 前额叶必需

sources.authors: Melloni L, Molina C, Pena M, Torres D, Singer W, Rodriguez E
sources.title: Synchronization of neural activity across cortical areas correlates with conscious perception
sources.role: 主要来源：长程伽马相位同步区分意识/无意识，局部伽马两者相似
sources.key_data: 长程gamma同步80-130ms; 局部gamma两种条件均有; P300样~240ms

sources.title: Is consciousness a gradual phenomenon? Evidence for an all-or-none bifurcation during the attentional blink
sources.role: 注意瞬脱期间意识全有或全无分布的证据
sources.key_data: 注意瞬脱期间报告呈双峰分布（见到或完全看不到），支持GWT的全有或全无点燃

sources.title: The distinct modes of vision offered by feedforward and recurrent processing
sources.role: RPT框架建立：前馈扫描（无意识）vs 递归处理（意识）
sources.key_data: 前馈：~100ms完成；递归：100-200ms启动；意识需要递归但不一定需要前额叶

sources.authors: Dehaene S, Changeux JP, Naccache L, Sackur J, Sergent C
sources.title: Conscious, preconscious, and subliminal processing: a testable taxonomy
sources.role: GWT的三层分类框架（阈下/前意识/意识）
sources.key_data: 意识=全局广播+额顶激活；前意识=强但无注意；阈下=被遮蔽或无注意的弱信号

sources.title: Is perception discrete or continuous?
sources.role: 知觉的离散性假说——丘脑皮层振荡构成~100ms知觉帧
sources.key_data: ~10Hz(alpha)振荡可能是知觉时间帧基础；预测：知觉时间分辨率约100ms

sources.title: How neuroscience will change our view on consciousness
sources.role: Lamme明确表达RPT立场：前额叶参与通达意识而非现象意识
sources.key_data: RPT立场：意识=递归处理；前额叶=报告系统；GWT混淆了通达意识与现象意识

sources.authors: Overgaard M, Rote J, Mouridsen K, Ramsøy TZ
sources.title: Is conscious perception gradual or dichotomous? A comparison of report methodologies during a visual task
sources.role: 反驳Sergent/Dehaene的全有或全无论点；支持连续梯度知觉
sources.key_data: 用连续量表测到中间知觉状态，与Sergent2004的双峰分布不一致
